lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\EmployeeDashboard\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 1 place. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.

1 transaction is opened and closed by hand. The trait TTransactional has atomic() since Nextcloud 24 and atomicRetry() since Nextcloud 27, which repeats a transaction that ran into a deadlock, as the manual recommends.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 4 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
